result.summary: A bar chart titled 'Enterprise BI: Too Little Data And Too Hard to Use' shows the reasons business and IT decision-makers avoid using enterprise BI applications. The top reason is 'Do not have all the data you need' at 45%, followed by complexity at 32%, lack of right data model at 31%, slow results at 29%, and restrictive data models at 23%.
key_facts: 45% of users avoid enterprise BI due to lack of data
32% cite complexity and difficulty of use
31% lack the right data model, relationships, attributes, hierarchies
Survey base: 302 business and IT decision-makers
Source: Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP, March 2014
visible_text: Enterprise BI: Too Little Data And Too Hard to Use
Why do you sometimes choose not to use enterprise BI applications?
Do not have all the data you need 45%
Are too complex, complicated, cumbersome to use 32%
Do not have the right data model, relationships, attributes, hierarchies 31%
Take too long to get results 29%
Have data models (relationships, keys, joins) that are too restrictive 23%
Base: 302 business and IT decision-makers who influence BI decisions
Source: A commissioned study conducted by Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP, March 2014
